name: agreementhub
description: AgreementHub: secure digital agreement platform (backend foundation)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run -w @agreementhub/api dev" "npm run -w @agreementhub/web dev"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run -w @agreementhub/web build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p packages/domain && tsc -p packages/contracts && tsc -p db && tsc -p apps/web
